summary: The required matrix contains 4^n explicit entries, establishing an output-size lower bound that the one-write-per-cell construction matches.

optimality.argument: Any correct implementation must materialize all 4^n matrix entries. The accepted recursive construction visits each leaf cell once and performs only constant work per recursion-tree node, whose total size is geometric in 4^n.

replacement_checks.evidence: Returning the explicit 2^n by 2^n matrix requires writing its 4^n distinct output entries.
The reference assigns each output cell once, and its four-way recursion tree contains O(4^n) total nodes.
Authored cases cover the one-cell base, the first two recursive levels, and a deeper three-level quadrant construction.
